title: Binary Tree Height
prompt:
Given the root of a binary tree (`Option<Box<TreeNode>>`, where each node has `val`, `left`, `right`), return the number of nodes on the longest path from the root down to any leaf. An empty tree (`None`) has height 0, and a single node has height 1.

Signature: `fn tree_height(root: &Option<Box<TreeNode>>) -> usize`

The starter provides `node(val, left, right)` and `leaf(val)` helpers for building trees.

Example:
        3
       / \
      9   20
         /  \
        15   7
  tree_height(&root) -> 3
